trust_name: Acrophyte Hospitality Trust (formerly ARA US Hospitality Trust)

currency.verified: Statement headers read 'US$'000'; functional currency USD (all borrowings and investments in USD). No conversion applied; all figures native as-reported.
currency.scale: financial statements in US$'000 -> multiplied x1000 to absolute; per-hotel valuation/revenue tables in US$ millions -> x1,000,000.

stapled_structure: Stapled Group = ACRO-REIT Group (owns hotels as investment properties, master-lessor) + ACRO-BT Group (master lessee, operates hotels; hotels appear as PPE). Statements present ACRO-REIT / ACRO-BT / Stapled Group columns. STAPLED GROUP column used as canonical throughout (per task instruction).

atoms_captured_thousands.notes: dep_pe = 'Depreciation of property, plant and equipment' C/F line (Stapled) 29,215 (income-statement D&A 29,241 also includes intangibles amortisation 26). fv_cf_signed (PPE reval -11,925 treated as IP-FV analogue per 2026-07-28 decision) = Net change in FV of investment properties C/F line = 0 at Stapled Group (no IP at stapled level; hotels are PPE). finance_costs = Note 20 gross finance-costs total (Stapled) 22,832 (not netted vs 71 finance income). capex_sum = 'Payment for capital expenditure' 20,462 (Acquisition of IP/PPE was 0 in FY2024 for Stapled).

derived_metrics_thousands_for_orchestrat.formulae: ebit=operating_income(NOI); depreciation=dep_pe+fv_cf_signed=29,215+11,925=41,140; ebitda=pretax(-23,978)+interest(22,832)+depreciation(41,140)=39,994; ffo=net_income(-23,692)+depreciation(41,140)-net_property_sales(0)=17,448. PPE-revaluation treated as IP-FV analogue (LOCKED 2026-07-28).

inferred: properties.category set to 'Specialized' for all 33 hotels (hospitality has no dedicated bucket in the canonical 6-value property taxonomy); category_raw carries the brand.

Per-hotel market_valuation/gross_revenue/occupancy aligned by row position across the facing-page split (name lists p14/p16 vs value tables p15/p17). Alignment VERIFIED: Sigma of 33 per-hotel valuations = US$728.0m, exactly matching the disclosed independent portfolio valuation (HVS, 31 Dec 2024).
performance.aggregate_leverage = 41.6% (average leverage per MAS Property Funds Appendix); net gearing separately disclosed at 39.1%.
anomalies_watchouts: HOTEL-TRUST / PPE REVALUATION MODEL: at Stapled Group the non-cash property revaluation flows through 'Revaluation of property, plant and equipment' -11,925 (P&L) rather than an investment-property fair-value line. The strict fv_cf_signed atom (IP fair value) is therefore 0, so the §6 depreciation/EBITDA/FFO derivations do NOT strip this -11,925 PPE revaluation drag. Flagged for the orchestrator: if PPE revaluation should be treated as the hotel-trust analogue of the IP-FV atom, fv_cf_signed would be 11,925 (giving depreciation 41,140, ebitda 39,994, ffo 17,448). Left at 0 to obey the literal §6 atom definition; not silently substituted. [RESOLVED 2026-07-28: PPE reval treated as IP-FV analogue -> fv_cf_signed=+11,925; depreciation 41,140, ebitda 39,994, ffo 17,448. See REFERENCE.md §6.]
income_taxes = -286 (a tax CREDIT of 286 at Stapled Group; negative under the positive-expense-magnitude convention). Reconciles: pretax -23,978 + 286 credit = net -23,692.

net_property_sales = 0: 3 hotels divested in FY2024 (gross US$38.7m; Stapled net proceeds from held-for-sale disposals US$37.361m) but no disposal gain/loss recognised through the Stapled Group P&L ('Net loss on disposition of PPE' and 'Net change in FV of assets held for sale' both nil in 2024).

trade_mix and top_tenants intentionally EMPTY: hospitality master-lease trust with guest (not tenant) income; no tenant-concentration or trade-mix disclosure. Master leases are internal (ACRO-REIT to ACRO-BT subsidiaries).
Name change effective 2 Oct 2024: ARA US Hospitality Trust -> Acrophyte Hospitality Trust; sponsor now Acrophyte Pte. Ltd. (formerly Chip Eng Seng Corporation Ltd.), Tang family.

columns_never_fillable.properties.gla: Not disclosed. Hotels disclose Number of Rooms (not lettable/floor area); no GLA/NLA/GFA in the report.
columns_never_fillable.properties.net_property_income: Structural: internal master-lease/operated hotel portfolio; NPI disclosed only at portfolio level (US$44.337m), not per hotel. Per-hotel figures are Revenue (captured as gross_revenue) and independent valuation.
columns_never_fillable.top_tenants: Structural: hospitality master-lease trust — guest income, no tenant-concentration table.
columns_never_fillable.trade_mix: Structural: hospitality trust — no trade-mix / by-industry disclosure.

data_with_no_home.number_of_rooms_per_hotel: Disclosed per hotel (p15/p17) and portfolio total 4,315 rooms; no schema field for room count.
data_with_no_home.year_of_last_renovation: Disclosed per hotel (p15/p17); no schema field.
data_with_no_home.brand_franchisers: Hyatt / Marriott / Hilton franchise brands; captured in category_raw.
data_with_no_home.weighted_avg_debt_maturity: Not disclosed as a WADM figure in the report (all-in cost of debt 6.7%, 47.5% hedged, term loans US$324.5m given instead); left null.

parsing_traps.facing_page_split: Portfolio is a facing-page positional split: hotel identity (State/City/Brand/Name) on p14 & p16, the numeric metrics (rooms/tenure/valuation/revenue/occupancy) on p15 & p17 with NO label column. Rows aligned by position; verified by valuation sum = 728.0m.
parsing_traps.stapled_columns: Three-way column layout (ACRO-REIT / ACRO-BT / Stapled Group) throughout the statements — must read the Stapled Group column, not the first numeric column.
parsing_traps.gross_revenue_recon_gap: Sum of 33 remaining hotels' revenue (161.9m) is ~4.1% below reported total revenue (168.778m) because 3 hotels divested mid-year (Pittsburgh Airport, Plymouth Meeting, Shelton) contributed partial-year revenue no longer in the year-end 33-hotel list. Legit gap, not a miss.

reconciliation.STR_signed: Sigma revenue (168,849) - Sigma expense (180,902) + Sigma adjustment (-11,639) = -23,692 = net_income (Total return for the year). PASS.
reconciliation.portfolio_valuation: Sigma 33 hotel valuations = 728.0m = disclosed portfolio valuation. PASS.
